Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. No prior injury to the cervical region is
known, and the available history contains no earlier complaints involving this area. Billing records show a single,
appropriate charge for each service, with no repeated entries. The patient has shown steady improvement and has
been discharged to home self-management, with follow-up available as needed.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
